Description: "Display server-synchronized today's and total credit sales in dashboard cards"
Instruction: "Update the Today's Credit Sales and Total Credit Sales DashboardCards to use stats property values"
ReplacementContent: "                              <DashboardCard title=\"Today's Credit Sales\" val={`${config.currency} ${stats.todayCreditSales.toFixed(2)}`} icon={<Coins size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />\n                              <DashboardCard title=\"Total Credit Sales\" val={`${config.currency} ${stats.totalCreditSales.toFixed(2)}`} icon={<Wallet size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />"
TargetContent: "                              <DashboardCard title=\"Today's Credit Sales\" val={`${config.currency} ${todayCreditSales.toFixed(2)}`} icon={<Coins size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />\n                              <DashboardCard title=\"Total Credit Sales\" val={`${config.currency} ${totalCreditSales.toFixed(2)}`} icon={<Wallet size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />"
